caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular box-shaped object with a wooden frame and a metal panel on the front side. The box has four turned wooden corner posts and an open slatted wooden top consisting of three rectangular sections. The front metal panel is decorated with a pattern of small circular holes arranged in a radiating or circular design, with a small round hole in its center. The panel is attached on the right side with metal hinges and has a small metal ring pull near the left edge, presumably for opening the panel. A thin wire handle, attached at opposite ends to the wooden frame on top, arches above the box in an upright position. The object is colored in muted tones, with the wood depicted in light brown shades and the metal panel shown in a grayish hue. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with soft shading around the box to suggest depth. There is faint text near the bottom edge of the box, including the date "July 1837."
title: Foot Warmer
